items.summary: Revert the application behavior to the version immediately prior to the latest deployment draft (the draft that introduced the new/updated “VAT priority logic”). This rollback must restore the previous VAT/invoice flow behavior and UI outputs as they were before the latest VAT-priority changes were applied.

Ensure the rollback does not break access to already-saved invoices. Existing invoice records must remain listable and viewable after the rollback (including any fields currently stored on backend invoice records such as currency and VAT label).

Update deployment verification to clearly indicate the rolled-back build version via the existing production marker mechanism, so that operators can confirm rollback in the browser console after deployment.
